Dear Nadia Noor,

Happy Birthday! 🎂

Dua hai tumhari zindagi hamesha khushiyon, sukoon aur khoobsurat lamhon se bhari rahe. Tumhare saare khwab poore hon, aur har naya din tumhare liye ek nayi wajah laaye muskurane ki.

Here's to you, and all the magic ahead. ♡
